paras: Application: Toyota GR Supra MK5 (A90 / A91) Part Type: Fuel line retaining kit Part Number: 20-0762

The Radium 20-0762 Fuel Line Retaining Kit replaces the factory plastic retainers that secure the OEM fuel feed and EVAP lines running from the rear to the front of the MK5 Supra with anodised billet aluminium clamshell retainers.
hl: Billet Retainers: Anodised 6061 aluminium clamshell retainers replace the OEM plastic items
Extra Line Positions: Additional hose locations for aftermarket 8AN feed and 6AN return lines
OEM Lines Retained: Secures the factory fuel feed and EVAP lines
No Modifications: Mounting hardware uses OEM threads – no drilling or cutting
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Line Retaining Kit for Toyota Supra A90 2019+
